description.description: A series of frames depicting various elements related to vaccination and DNA. Each frame features a consistent layout: the top section contains an artistic illustration of a biomechanical or 'digitized' arm reaching toward a human finger, reminiscent of Michelangelo's 'Creation of Adam'. The bottom section for each frame has a black banner with white text that reads 'THE JABBED HAVE DIFFERENT DNA'. The center section varies; it features different individuals or documents: a woman in a blue jacket, a man in a suit, and a scientific paper titled 'Intracellular Reverse Transcription of Pfizer BioNTech COVID-19 mRNA Vaccine BNT162b2 In Vitro in Human Liver Cell Line'. A watermark '@Endilluminati' is visible across the middle of the frames.
